newsitem.title: USA: Triangle Imaging says repurchased shares.
newsitem.headline: Triangle Imaging says repurchased shares.

text.p: Triangle Imaging Group Inc said on Tuesday that it repurchased 500,000 shares of its own issued and outstanding common stock from Engineered Business Systems (EBS).
This block of stock represented all of the shares issued to EBS when Triangle purchased EBS in December 1996, the company said in a statement.
This purchase reduces the outstanding shares of Triangle and removes many restrictive covenants which were contained in the rights agreement from the EBS purchase.
Vito Bellezza, President of Triangle, said, "With the recision of the rights agreement, it gives Triangle unlimited flexibility for acquisitions, financings and other merchant banking activities."
Triangle is a holding company which owns EBS, a computer software company for credit reporting.
